title: EDC Las Vegas 2011 Montage
description:
My adventure of such a magical weekend. Three fun-filled nights with 6 massive stages with world class DJs and endless visual arts and carnival rides. 
________________________________________

Video Specs:

-Canon 7D 
-Canon 50mm 1.8
-Sigma 10mm 2.8 Fisheye 
-GoPro HD 
-iPhone 4G
-Cut/Graded in FCP
-Music: Calvin Harris feat. Kelis - Bounce (R3hab Remix)





Unfortunately it's difficult to obtain press passes into huge music festivals so I snuck in a GoPro HD to capture as much footage as possible.

------------
Insomniac presents: Electric Daisy Carnival 2011
